description: Fixture F2, ODC mirror (lote 4): one set StyleSheet on every place a delivery can put CSS, over the consumer of css-chain-consumer.json. Each result carries css.placement (what serves the CSS at runtime) and the receipt cssPlacement: the local theme served by ChainFlow, the module's default theme, the block ChainCard placed on ChainScreen, the block ChainUnusedCard that no page places (warning CSS_TARGET_UNSERVED) and the screen with its chain of themes (the producer's included).
